notes:
Lead profile: small legal-tech startup building a lawyer-facing doc search assistant. Inbound → read Redwood blog on RAG. Wants hosted API (self-serve) — prefers not to manage infra.

Highlights from discovery call:
- Dataset: ~50k internal docs (contracts, briefs, templates). Mostly text, some scanned PDFs (OCR done).
- Primary workload: semantic search + short generative follow-ups (answer synthesis), heavy reliance on embeddings + reranking.
- Latency target: 150-300ms for retrieval path; can accept higher latency for final long-form synthesis.
- Throughput: low (5-15 qps), cost sensitivity high — target <$0.02/query expressed repeatedly.
- Preferred vector stores: experimenting with pgvector (Supabase) and Pinecone for managed option. Wants examples for both.
- Routing/fallback: wants simple policy — prefer original high-quality model when available, fallback to smaller cheaper model automatically if quota/exhaustion.

Security/compliance notes:
- SOC2 required for any production contract. SSO/SAML for admin. Audit logs/retention for user interactions (legal compliance). Mentioned potential future need for data residency (EU customers).

Customer quotes (paraphrased):
- 'We need good recall on contract clauses — embeddings must capture legal semantics.'
- 'Cost is a blocker — we can't justify a big bill right now, want to see tradeoffs.'

Technical asks: example code for embedding + upsert to pgvector, sample reranking pipeline using hosted API (+ cost estimate), guide for choosing embedding dimension and model family, recommendation for automatic fallback routing to cheaper model.

Sales notes / tone: friendly, pragmatic, self-serve first. AE to prioritize quick wins: give working notebook + Pinecone + pgvector examples, short spike showing 100-query eval comparing rerankers. If results promising, convert to low-tier reserved usage.

Stubs/links: drive PoC spec uploaded (link above), GitHub demo repo: github.com/greystone/docs-rag-demo (customer-owned), Gmail thread id thread/1a9b2c3d4e.

Next immediate actions: send trial API keys + sample notebook (Marcus), attach SOC2 summary doc, request short Pinecone trial access (sales).
